rate_mismatch_seek.domain: Finite positive normal rates, finite nonnegative positions and intermediate signed64 conversion results. Oracle uses nearest/ties-even FP rounding as an explicit assumption; target FPCR was not observed.

rate_mismatch_seek.caveat: Cluster read ignores the wrapper seek return. This seek contract alone does not establish the number or content of samples returned by the differing-rate converter.

analysis_limits: REA raw slices omit imported symbols, global data, original vtables and full exception context; original-image instructions plus separately pinned pointer bytes are authoritative.
LC_FUNCTION_STARTS interval is not proof of a body. Retained intervals include exception tails and, for the clone, a distinct registration routine after RET.
C-like decompiler expressions and inferred ABI types are not compilable or bit-faithful recovered source.
Analytical vectors execute self-authored integer/Fraction IEEE arithmetic only. No source backend, decoder or Cubase function ran.
